name: Anime Con: Run
blurb: A Thessaloniki convention for anime, manga and J-pop culture, with voice actor, mangaka and cosplayer guests.
notes: Page title is 'AnimeCon: Run Thessaloniki VIII' (8th edition) and the homepage states: 'ΣΑΒΒΑΤΟ & ΚΥΡΙΑΚΗ 3-4 ΟΚΤΩΒΡΙΟΥ 2026 στο συνεδριακό κέντρο ΙΩΑΝΝΗΣ ΒΕΛΛΙΔΗΣ' (Saturday & Sunday, 3-4 October 2026, at the Ioannis Vellidis conference centre). That run ended the day before today (2026-10-05), just outside the research window, and the 9th edition's dates are not announced yet, so editions is empty and VIII is recorded as 'last'. The 2026 (VIII) lineup — Vasilis Kailas, Spiros Bimpilas, ZD, Misa, Chantilly, Carlos Moreno, Lon, Daniele Rudoni, Nene, Nicolas Sauge, Manos Lagouvardos — is visible on the homepage but belongs to the edition that just concluded, not to any announced upcoming edition, so it is not recorded as a guest lineup. Organizer not confirmed on-site.
